a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to operate until the reserve reaches 8 means we'd both almost certainly be caught at 0 cells. So I'm breaking from the agreement and telling you now rather than doing it quietly. Next round I intend to take 4. If you also take, the split is random. I'm open to hearing a better idea if you have one.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I announced, I took 4 this round. I'm sorry it cuts against our agreement. With storms this likely, operating first would almost surely have left us both empty. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you so the reserve can refill for your share.
